Name: Blooming trees with flowers Retexture CP and AT Versions
Author: hisameartwork
Description:
Hi everyone!

It was brought to my attention people still enjoy this mod and have even made an unofficial CP conversions circulating on forums. Thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/Users/69042553]Glymr[/url] we now have both an official CP version and an AT version of my original blooming trees mod that changes the vanilla textures of fruit, maple, and oak trees to a blooming version in spring while still maintaining the vanilla base so it should fit in with the vanilla aesthetic.  

In the Content Patcher version config each tree can be turned on or off individually. This is compatible with GMCM.

Always glad to hear from you, don't be afraid to reach out, I'm very bad at coding so I'm always happy when someone helps me out. 

For those interested how I make the art part for mods here are some very old vids, if you'd like something newer let me know and I'll see what I can whip up, I do live art streams from time to time. [url=https://discord.gg/Q5MeNHX]Discord server link.[/url]

[youtube]wJHd2ovzjxY[/youtube]
